protocol.source_path: 基金/006373_国富全球科技互联混合_QDII_人民币A/历史净值/006373_全部历史净值_截至2026-10-15.json
protocol.data_scope: Local archived public third-party NAV; no new independent official full-series reconstruction
protocol.normalization: Hypothetical annual budget=1; no investor account data or amounts
protocol.funding: Year-first NAV buy; startup budget=(13-start_month)/12, later years=1, including unfinished final year. Annual purchases reset anchors and cancel pending signals.
protocol.signal: Unit NAV relative to preceding executed trade NAV. Sell fraction of execution fund value. Buy gross budget fraction of preceding post-trade fund value. Both anchors reset only after execution.
protocol.cash: Zero interest; no borrowing. Base accounting treats sale proceeds available at execution; real redemption settlement is not reconstructed. Extra cash supplied externally if needed; not returns.
protocol.objective: Maximize annualized TWR / maximum TWR drawdown (Calmar) among eligible finite-grid rules
protocol.alternatives: Maximum CAGR and minimum drawdown in identical eligible set; all feasible Pareto frontier disclosed
protocol.tie_break: Calmar rounded12 decimals, fewer tactical trades, lower normalized extra, distance to40/30 reference, lexicographic
protocol.chronology: Expanding annual training with >=730 calendar days; freeze each rule and test following calendar year. Main train through2025, test2026. Full-history descriptive search LAST.
protocol.validation_scope: Retrospective chronological diagnostics, not prospectively untouched data; current partial2026 is a short regime sample
protocol.robustness: Fixed winners only: lag1/2/3/5, no fees, official standard subscription, all accounting dates, ordinary subscription start, redemption settlement weekday approximation, grid neighbors; no reselection.
protocol.limitations: NAV observation days are not fully reconstructed dealing days. Historical suspension, purchase limits, publication/confirmation/settlement dates, historical discounts are not modeled. Inception buy is idealized; ordinary-open-start sensitivity reported.

status: Historical finite-grid candidates; not accepted rules or automatic trading instructions
